_comment: AP-6 (815-autopilot-remediation-router.md) — I1's routing table, literal, as the design doc's own words name it: 'маршрутная таблица (детерминированная, config/autopilot/routing.json)'. Single source of truth for scripts/autopilot/autopilot_common.py's ROUTE_CLASS/ROUTING (loaded at import, never re-typed as a second dict). LAW (C0.6, M, J1): no kind may carry route_class AUTO or AUTO_NO_MODEL for a money-shaped fact — enforced at LOAD TIME in _load_routing() (fails closed, not just checked once in a test) and again in incident-cli.py --selftest as a test on ABSENCE.
_fields: route_class: AUTO (fleet task, model spend, REVIEW as given) | AUTO_NO_MODEL (engine self-action, zero model, zero fleet task) | MIXED (engine self-action + a diagnostic-only fleet task) | HUMAN_KEY (WAITING_HUMAN via the existing connected_db.py key contour, bridged by AP-6) | HUMAN_ONLY (money/CAPTCHA/etc — WAITING_HUMAN + operator file, no autobranch ever) | HUMAN_GENERIC (WAITING_HUMAN + operator file, unclassifiable). review: fable|none|null (null = no fleet task is ever generated for this kind, so REVIEW is meaningless). fleet_task: whether route_auto_incidents() ever files a taskloop/queue/ file for this kind.
